title: Collections Calendar for Home Purchase Financing — Delinquency, Credit Reporting, Right to Cure and Charge-Off
content:
**Collections department milestone calendar.** Days past due are counted on the oldest unpaid installment of a Home Purchase Financing loan.

| Milestone | 7-Year Fixed | 10-Year Fixed | 15-Year Fixed | 20-Year Fixed | 23-Year Fixed | 25-Year Fixed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loan becomes delinquent (days past due) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Delinquency reported to the credit bureaus (days past due) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Right-to-cure notice sent (days past due) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Cure period after the right-to-cure notice date (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Delinquent loan charged off (days past due) | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |

(Program columns are the Home-Only Loan programs of the same names.)

**Milestones in sequence on one hypothetical loan.** For an oldest unpaid installment that stays unpaid, the calendar places delinquency and credit reporting at 30 days past due, the right-to-cure notice at 45 days past due with a cure deadline 30 calendar days after that notice's date, and charge-off at 120 days past due. A notice dated 2026-02-14 carries a cure deadline of 2026-03-16.
